question_text: A government agency's annual budget is P15,000,000. If 24% goes to personnel, how much is that?

hint_ladder.title: Convert 24% to decimal
hint_ladder.text: 24% = 0.24. Multiply 15M times 0.24. O hatiin sa 100: 15M ÷ 100 = 150,000. Tapos i-times 24.

hint_ladder.title: Break into easy parts
hint_ladder.text: 150k × 20 = 3,000,000; 150k × 4 = 600,000. Isipin mong bumibili ng 20+4 na kilo ng bigas sa palengke.

hint_ladder.title: Check with neighbors
hint_ladder.text: 24% ng 15M ay malapit sa 25% (3.75M) at 20% (3M). Dapat 3.6M, tama yan. Cancel-zero trick: (Total/100) × Percent.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you added only 200k after computing 150k×20, instead of adding 600k for 150k×4.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you multiplied 150k by 22 instead of 24, then rounded up.

C.text: Correct. 24% ng 15M ay P3,600,000. Cancel zeros technique ang sagot!

D.text: You might have chosen D because you mistakenly used 25% (P3.75M) and rounded up to P3.8M.

next_time_rule: 💡 Key Takeaway: For percent of a big number, divide by 100 first: (Total ÷ 100) × Percent. 24% of 15M = (15M/100) × 24 = 150k × 24.
deconstruct_text:
Sa budget ng LGU na P15,000,000, 24% ay napupunta sa personnel. Gusto ni Kapitan malaman ang eksaktong halaga. Let's compute it, bes!

Convert 24% to decimal: 0.24. Multiply: 0.24 × 15,000,000. O hatiin muna sa 100: 15,000,000 ÷ 100 = 150,000.

Then multiply by 24: 150,000 × 20 = 3,000,000; 150,000 × 4 = 600,000. Add: P3,600,000. Ang dali, 'di ba?

Mental trick: isipin mong bumibili ng tinda sa palengke. Kung 24 items na tig-150k, total 3.6M. Sa exam, cancel zeros lang.
